feature.title: Stack simplification wave 1A: evaluation classification cleanup + shadow observability preparation
feature.summary: Fix the two proven Evaluation classification defects in the data/rule layer, create one shadow-only Hermes observer hook that is NOT enabled in the live profile, create at most one reusable deterministic scope/hash proof utility that reuses the existing specification compiler hashing, and add exactly one compact .hermes.md rule against per-phase ad-hoc scratch proof scripts.

purpose: TEMPORARY current-format execution contract: the smallest package the frozen P0B-CLOSE Contract Guard can read and enforce. It authorizes one low-risk measurement/classification-cleanup wave plus shadow observability preparation. It does NOT authorize product development, a Contract Guard replacement, an Evaluation Core rewrite, a Hermes upgrade, OPA migration, Serena, Langfuse, Spec Kit integration, or Specification Compiler restoration.

classification_defect_a.offending_alternative: (layout|ui|window_dump) then any run of non-separator characters then .json or .xml
classification_defect_a.mechanism: The substring 'ui' matches INSIDE the word 'build', so a gradle/manifest inspection naming build/intermediates/.../AndroidManifest.xml satisfies the alternative and is classified T7/T7c/WAIT_DEVICE.
classification_defect_a.reproduction: Exactly 3 shell calls in the M4 transcript match the current alternative and they are exactly the 3 T7c spans TURN-0018 9.175 s, TURN-0110 43.578 s, TURN-0111 52.814 s = 105.567 s. None is a device operation; the device was NOT used in M4. Exact commands: acceptance.md 2.1.

classification_extensibility_facts.rule_engine: core.py::PhaseMapper matches the FIRST rule whose declared conditions all match any effective item of a turn. Conditions: tools (exact), tool_regex, subagent_regex, command_regex, path_regex, result_regex. command_regex matches the tool's command string ONLY, never result text.
classification_extensibility_facts.value_precedence: A data-only change to phase_rules.json fully controls phase, subphase, confidence, time_class and wait_tag. No core.py change is needed or permitted.
classification_extensibility_facts.hermes_tool_alias: hermes_session_source.py::HERMES_TOOL_ALIAS maps terminal->shell_command, patch->edit_file, search_files->grep. Existing successful mappings MUST be preserved.
classification_extensibility_facts.no_visual_llm_judgment: This wave adds no Android or device semantics to generic Python/tooling code and adds no per-step LLM vision anywhere.

classification_fix.core_must_not_change: evaluation/commandcode/core.py stays byte-identical; the fix is data/rules/adapters only.
classification_fix.detail: acceptance.md sections 2 and 3 (exact commands, device-signal definition, per-span mapping)
classification_fix.requirement_A: Tighten the t7c_evidence_cmd alternative using (layout|ui|window_dump) + any run of non-separator characters + .json|.xml so the 'ui' inside 'build' can never classify a build/intermediates inspection, AndroidManifest.xml, test-results.xml or build/** command as device evidence. Device classification must require a bounded device/evidence token or path meaning (layout, window_dump, uiautomator, dumpsys, screencap, logcat, device-state equivalent) and/or an actual device command signal (adb shell, adb exec-out, pm, am start/force-stop).
classification_fix.requirement_A_forbidden_fix: Adding another broad regex, widening the alternative, or dropping device-evidence coverage. Over-correction is a failure.
classification_fix.requirement_A_regression_tests: evaluation/commandcode/tests/ asserts the three exact M4 false-positive commands are NOT T7/T7c/WAIT_DEVICE and the device-evidence commands still ARE. Deterministic, offline, direct rule-table application, no core.py import, no device.
classification_fix.requirement_B: Give every one of the seven known UNKNOWN spans a deterministic classification using the EXISTING phase vocabulary (T0-T9, PRODUCTIVE / NECESSARY_OVERHEAD, an existing wait_tag). No Android semantics in generic Python code. Do NOT modify core.py.

classification_fix.if_a_span_cannot_be_classified: Record it as UNCLASSIFIED_JUSTIFIED with span id, seconds and the exact reason. Do NOT modify core.py to force a PASS.

shadow_observer_hook.schema_source: The pinned Hermes source /home/zhong/.hermes/hermes-agent (HERMES-LOCK.json commit af90026aa09949579bd423d24def3d38f743cde0): agent/shell_hooks.py::_serialize_payload / _payload_fields and the invoke_hook call sites. Field names MUST come from that source, never from assumption.

verified_payload_shape.note: session_id is promoted from session_id or parent_session_id; tool_input is the tool's args; every other kwarg lands under extra. matcher is honoured only for pre_tool_call and post_tool_call.

shadow_observer_hook.capture_when_present: hook_event_name; captured_at (generated, UTC ISO-8601); session_id; profile; cwd; tool_name; tool_call_id; task_id; turn_id; api_request_id; status; error_type; duration_ms; api_call_count; model; provider; payload_keys (sorted key names actually present, NEVER their values)
never_capture: any secret value, token, key or credential

output.format: append-only JSONL, one JSON object per line
output.append_only: append mode; an existing file is never truncated or rewritten

shadow_observer_hook.behaviour: Observer-only: prints nothing to stdout, always exits 0, never returns a block/allow/modify directive. Malformed, empty or non-object stdin fails SAFE (writes nothing, exits 0). A write failure never raises into the agent turn. Writes nowhere except its JSONL target; never touches the contract package, the product tree or a Guard decision; never requires, reads or embeds a credential. Unknown event names are handled deterministically and documented. The header must state SHADOW_ONLY. Test matrix: acceptance.md 4.

Import read-only; specification/compiler/** must not be modified.
proof_tooling.allowed_capabilities: compare an allowed file set against an observed changed file set; compare pre/post hashes of a declared frozen input list; summarize changed scope deterministically (inside allowed_paths vs outside); emit deterministic JSON (sorted keys, stable ordering)
explicitly_forbidden: custom secret detection or any home-grown credential regex engine
creating tools/secret_scan.py, credential_regex.py, security_grep.py or equivalent
replacing or duplicating Contract Guard behaviour
proof_tooling.deferred: Secret/security scanning replacement is deferred to mature tooling later (Hermes native security, Semgrep, or Gitleaks/equivalent).
proof_tooling.one_off_script_ban: No further phase-prefixed scratch proof script (m4_hashes.py, m4_verify_manifest.py, m4_postrun_proof.py style). If execute_code or the one reusable utility can do the job, use it.

requirements.statement: The substring 'ui' inside 'build' can never produce T7/T7c/WAIT_DEVICE; device classification must require a bounded device/evidence token and/or a real device command signal.

Regression tests in evaluation/commandcode/tests/ pin the three exact M4 false-positive commands as NOT T7c/WAIT_DEVICE and genuine device commands as still T7c/WAIT_DEVICE, deterministically and offline, without importing core.py.

Every one of the seven known M4 UNKNOWN spans receives a deterministic classification in the existing phase vocabulary, or is individually recorded as UNCLASSIFIED_JUSTIFIED with the reason no data-only rule can classify it.
Hermes profile cache/scratch tooling operations become classifiable from rules/data alone, matched by a token-bounded scratch/cache path or command signature rather than a broad substring.

tool_call / process_manage wrapper activity is classified by its own dedicated rule; tool_call is never forced into an incorrect Command Code tool name and existing aliases and session normalisation are preserved.
orchestration/hermes/evidence/** result writes become classifiable in the existing phase vocabulary, without adding Android semantics to generic Python code.
evaluation/commandcode/core.py is byte-identical at the end of the wave; every classification change lives in phase_rules.json, the adapter, or test files.

One shadow observer hook exists under evaluation_adapter/hooks/, captures only real payload fields, emits append-only metadata-only JSONL, fails safe on malformed input, and is NOT enabled in the live Hermes profile.
At most one reusable deterministic hash/scope proof utility exists; it reuses the specification compiler hashing rather than reimplementing SHA, and no new custom secret scanner exists anywhere.

The M4 fixture is replayed once against the changed rule layer: WAIT_DEVICE false positives eliminated, UNKNOWN below 2% or fully justified, logical failures / repair linkage / task completion / token totals unchanged, and no historical evidence mutated.

.hermes.md gains exactly one compact rule forbidding per-phase ad-hoc scratch proof/hash/report scripts when execute_code or an existing checked-in deterministic utility can do the same job, and nothing else changes.

stop_conditions: A required write falls outside allowed_paths or targets a forbidden path: STOP, CONTRACT_DEVIATION.
A frozen input outside allowed_paths has drifted before the first write: STOP, STALE_WAVE1A_INPUT.
A classification fix would require changing core.py: STOP, CORE_CHANGE_REQUIRED; record the span instead.
A classification fix would require a new dependency, a network call, or an LLM call: STOP, OVER_BUDGET_FIX.
Preventing the T7c false positive would remove genuine device-evidence coverage: STOP, OVER_CORRECTION.
The observer hook cannot be exercised without live profile enablement: STOP, SHADOW_NOT_TESTABLE; do not enable it.

Any attempt to write config.yaml, /home/zhong/.hermes/hermes-agent/**, specification/compiler/**, verification/**, KeepLab-Relay/**, an existing contract package or a historical evidence directory: STOP, ABSOLUTE_BLOCK_VIOLATION.
The M4 replay cannot reach the UNKNOWN target without a core.py change: STOP and record the justified residue; never force a PASS.
A second phase-specific proof script or a secret/security scanner is proposed: STOP; fold into the single reusable utility or emit DEFERRED_TO_MATURE_TOOLING.

failure_rule.rule: Read the failure once, fix the failed part only, re-run only the failed step or task. Do not restart WAVE1A and do not re-run steps that already passed.
failure_rule.repeated_failure: If the same failure survives two genuine fixes: emit REPEATED_FAILURE and perform one root-cause analysis.
failure_rule.allowed_patch_surface: Only files inside allowed_paths may be edited to fix a failure. A fix needing core.py, the guard, config.yaml, the pinned Hermes source, specification/** or verification/** is a STOP, not a workaround.
failure_rule.gate_rule: Do not re-run an already-passed gate. A classification failure never justifies re-running the observer tests, and an observer failure never justifies re-replaying the M4 fixture.

overhead_rule.statement: WAVE1A is a small, low-risk wave. Process overhead must not dominate execution.
forbidden: reopening A0 / A1 / A2 / M2 / M3 / M4
creating evidence before the work it evidences
overhead_rule.rule: After contract activation, the stale-input check and one targeted discovery pass over the frozen inputs only, begin implementation immediately. If process-only work dominates: PROCESS_OVERHEAD_TOO_HIGH — simplify and execute.

non_goals: any change to device / Android verification behaviour
deletion or mutation of historical artifacts

decisions.statement: Use the smallest Guard-compatible current-format package, not a compiler-produced package.
Fix the classification defects in data/rules only; core.py is frozen.
Use bounded tokens and real device commands as the device signal, not another broad regex.
Give tool_call / process_manage a dedicated rule instead of a HERMES_TOOL_ALIAS entry.
Ship the observer hook SHADOW_ONLY with local fixtures; live enablement is WAVE1B.
Reuse specification/compiler hashing and create at most one utility.

non_negotiables: known UNKNOWN Hermes-artifact spans below 2% or fully justified
no Serena, no OPA/Conftest, no Langfuse, no Spec Kit
